overview: The committee met to review the monthly City Council newsletter and discuss proposals for holding public listening sessions and neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: City Council Newsletter Review
items.summary: Approved the City Council newsletter for publication and circulation, subject to edits that incorporate late December council meetings and refine specific resolution descriptions.

items.title: Resolution to Establish City Council Listening Sessions
items.summary: Kept the resolution in committee following discussion on resident outreach methods and potential redundancies with proposed neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: Resolution to Schedule Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Kept the resolution in committee after discussing meeting formats, potential locations, and planning a pilot program starting with Wards 8 and 4.
